5. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no previous criminal history.
6. It has further been stated that the parties have already settled their dispute amicably and the informant has given an application in this regard to the Superintendent of Police, Barabanki.
This fact is not disputed by the learned counsel for the informant.
7. Keeping in view the aforesaid facts, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

9. Let the applicant- Ajay Kumar be released on bail in the aforesaid case, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned.
(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.)
